name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; descriptor 'blit_sprite_with_stride_setup' accurately states what the body does: it sets up the destination stride (stores it into the wPitch global) before handing off to the inner blit loop fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_loop. Cleanly paired with the inner loop's name. No address residue.
purpose: Outer setter for a transparent-zero sprite blit with a caller-chosen destination stride: stores the stride into the shared glyph/blit render-state global, then calls the inner copy loop.
logic_summary: Body (3 lines): data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state.wPitch = (uint16)stride; then fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_loop(dst, sprite_hdr). The stride lives in a global (wPitch @ 0x627A3) rather than a register so the inner loop can also be entered directly when wPitch is already set; this wrapper is the entry used when a different stride is needed. Disasm confirms: [EBP+8]->EDI(dst), [EBP+0xC]->ESI(sprite_hdr), [EBP+0x10]->AX stored at [0x627A3](stride low16), CALL 0x4E9FF, PUSHAD/POPAD wrap, plain RET (cdecl, callers ADD ESP,0xC). EAX untouched so the decompiler 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact; all 9 callers discard it -> void.
signature: void fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_setup(uint32 dst, uint32 sprite_hdr, uint32 stride)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row base of where the sprite is painted); forwarded unchanged via EDI to the inner loop.
params.reason: Accurately names the destination pointer; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Sprite header pointer (width word 0, height word 2, then width*height raw pixel bytes; zero pixel = transparent); forwarded unchanged via ESI to the inner loop.
params.reason: Accurately names the sprite header pointer matching the inner loop's usage.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance dst per row; only the low 16 bits are stored into the wPitch field of data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state (word store MOV [0x627A3],AX).
params.reason: Accurately names the row-stride value; matches the wPitch store and the inner loop's per-row reload.

returns.semantics: No meaningful return. PUSHAD/POPAD wrap leaves EAX at entry value; the decompiler's 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact and all 9 callers discard the result.

writes_globals: data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state.wPitch (0x627A3) -- destination row stride for the subsequent inner blit loop
notes: Disasm at 0x4E9E4 verifies the cdecl stack->register mapping and the word-only wPitch store at 0x627A3, fully consistent with src lines 1871-1876, the src comment (1834-1870), and the Ghidra plate. wPitch global offset 0x627A3 matches data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state declared at 0x627A3 in blitspr.c. src comment and plate already precise and mutually consistent -> no edits to either. No logic touched.
